steps.reason: stop everything that holds /dev/sda (mounts, swap, LVM, md, dm)
remove the signatures of the old content of /dev/sda (its partitions first)
zero the first and last 16 MiB of /dev/sda
recreate the GPT of d0 with its identifiers (PARTUUIDs stay)
create vfat f0 with its UUID and recorded features
create btrfs f1 with its UUID and recorded features
mount the top level of f1 to create its subvolumes
unmount the top level of f1
restore the files of the snapshot
create mount points and API folders that the snapshot may lack
rebuild the initramfs of 5.15.0-125-generic with MODULES=most
check the restored system (identities, fstab, boot files)
